annotation_method: Reference rules written by direct reading of full public criteria before scoring, independently of parser predictions. Development sample, not held out and not clinically reviewed.
selection: Five complete recruiting records selected from leukemia and diabetes searches to include short and long criteria, age, diagnosis, a timed HbA1c threshold, a source hemoglobin unit, nested lists and unsupported conditions. Not random or representative. No sex reference rule occurs.
scope: Only self-contained age, sex, diagnosis and supported lab comparisons. Temporal diagnoses, alternatives and clinical judgments remain unknown. A clear compound age range has two reference rules even though the conservative parser abstains.
